steps.name: environment - install Android command-line SDK and configure environment
steps.description: Install minimal system packages (unzip, jq, optionally rsync), ensure suitable JDK (install openjdk-17 if missing; allow JAVA_HOME_OVERRIDE or install openjdk-11 if project requires it), download and install Android command-line tools idempotently into /opt/android-sdk with correct cmdline-tools/latest layout, install platform-tools and requested build-tools, detect build-tools bin and persist ANDROID_HOME/ANDROID_SDK_ROOT and discovered JAVA_HOME and build-tools bin PATH via /etc/profile.d/android_env.sh (variables expanded at write time). Export JAVA_HOME and PATH in the current shell before calling sdkmanager and accepting licenses. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/food-delivery-app-46009-46018/food_delivery_native_app.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE=${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/food-delivery-app-46009-46018/food_delivery_native_app}
sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y -q unzip wget ca-certificates jq || { echo "ERROR: apt-get install failed" >&2; exit 10; }
# Ensure rsync present (used for safe copy), fallback to cp if not
if ! command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get install -y -q rsync || true; fi
# Ensure Java: prefer existing JAVA_HOME_OVERRIDE if set
if [ -n "${JAVA_HOME_OVERRIDE:-}" ]; then export JAVA_HOME="$JAVA_HOME_OVERRIDE"; fi
if ! command -v javac >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get install -y -q openjdk-17-jdk || { echo "ERROR: failed to install openjdk-17" >&2; exit 11; }; fi
# Detect JAVA_HOME
JAVAC_PATH=$(command -v javac || true)
if [ -n "$JAVAC_PATH" ]; then JAVA_HOME_DETECTED=$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f "$JAVAC_PATH"))); else JAVA_HOME_DETECTED=${JAVA_HOME:-/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64}; fi
[ -d "$JAVA_HOME_DETECTED" ] || { echo "ERROR: JAVA_HOME not found: $JAVA_HOME_DETECTED" >&2; exit 12; }
export JAVA_HOME="$JAVA_HOME_DETECTED"
# Prepare Android SDK root
ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk
sudo mkdir -p "$ANDROID_HOME" && sudo chown -R $(id -u):$(id -g) "$ANDROID_HOME"
# Download commandline tools and extract
CMDLINE_ZIP_URL="https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-latest.zip"
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
ZIP="$TMPDIR/cmdline-tools.zip"
for i in 1 2 3; do wget -q -O "$ZIP" "$CMDLINE_ZIP_URL" && break || sleep 2; done
unzip -q "$ZIP" -d "$TMPDIR" || { echo "ERROR: unzip failed" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 13; }
# Locate extracted sdkmanager and normalize layout to /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/(cmdline-tools|bin)
SDKMANAGER_SRC=$(find "$TMPDIR" -type f -name sdkmanager -print -quit || true)
if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER_SRC" ]; then echo "ERROR: sdkmanager not found in archive" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 14; fi
EXTRACT_ROOT=$(dirname $(dirname "$SDKMANAGER_SRC"))
TARGET_DIR="$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest"
sudo mkdir -p "$TARGET_DIR"
# copy preserving contents; prefer rsync
if command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then rsync -a "$EXTRACT_ROOT/" "$TARGET_DIR/"; else cp -a "$EXTRACT_ROOT/." "$TARGET_DIR/"; fi
rm -rf "$TMPDIR"
# Ensure bin path exists (sdkmanager at latest/bin or latest/cmdline-tools/bin)
if [ ! -x "$TARGET_DIR/bin/sdkmanager" ]; then
  if [ -x "$TARGET_DIR/cmdline-tools/bin/sdkmanager" ]; then mkdir -p "$TARGET_DIR/bin" && cp -a "$TARGET_DIR/cmdline-tools/bin/." "$TARGET_DIR/bin/"; fi
fi
export ANDROID_HOME="$ANDROID_HOME" ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"
export PATH="$TARGET_DIR/bin:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$PATH"
# Validate sdkmanager runs
if ! command -v sdkmanager >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: sdkmanager not on PATH" >&2; exit 15; fi
# Accept licenses (use exported JAVA_HOME in current shell)
yes | sdkmanager --sdk_root="$ANDROID_HOME" --licenses || { echo "ERROR: accepting SDK licenses" >&2; exit 16; }
# Install platform-tools and platform
sdkmanager --sdk_root="$ANDROID_HOME" "platform-tools" "platforms;android-33" || { echo "ERROR: sdkmanager install platform/packages failed" >&2; exit 17; }
# Install build-tools if missing
BUILD_TOOLS_VER=33.0.2
if [ ! -d "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/$BUILD_TOOLS_VER" ]; then sdkmanager --sdk_root="$ANDROID_HOME" "build-tools;$BUILD_TOOLS_VER" || { echo "ERROR: sdkmanager install build-tools failed" >&2; exit 18; }; fi
# Discover installed build-tools bin
BUILD_TOOLS_BIN=$(ls -d "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools"/*/ 2>/dev/null | tail -n1 || true)
BUILD_TOOLS_BIN=${BUILD_TOOLS_BIN%/}
[ -n "$BUILD_TOOLS_BIN" ] || { echo "ERROR: no build-tools found" >&2; exit 19; }
# Persist env with expanded variables
sudo bash -c "cat > /etc/profile.d/android_env.sh <<EOF
export ANDROID_HOME=\"$ANDROID_HOME\"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=\"$ANDROID_HOME\"
export JAVA_HOME=\"$JAVA_HOME_DETECTED\"
export PATH=\"$TARGET_DIR/bin:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$BUILD_TOOLS_BIN:\$PATH\"
EOF"
sudo chmod 0755 /etc/profile.d/android_env.sh
# Validate tools
java -version >/dev/null || { echo "ERROR: java not usable" >&2; exit 20; }
sdkmanager --version || { echo "ERROR: sdkmanager not usable" >&2; exit 21; }

steps.name: dependencies - fetch Gradle deps and optional JS deps; install NDK if requested
steps.description: Refresh Gradle dependencies using the Gradle wrapper (no full assemble). Install node modules only if package.json exists. Detect ndkVersion in gradle.properties and install that exact NDK via sdkmanager if required; otherwise skip NDK installation. Also perform a Gradle/Java compatibility check by reading gradle-wrapper.properties and running ./gradlew -v to warn if Java 17 may be incompatible; allow override to JAVA_HOME_OVERRIDE to use a different JDK. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace-code-generation/food-delivery-app-46009-46018/food_delivery_native_app.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE=${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/food-delivery-app-46009-46018/food_delivery_native_app}
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Check gradle wrapper and compatibility
if [ -f gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties ]; then
  DIST_URL=$(awk -F= '/distributionUrl/ {print $2; exit}' gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties || true)
  echo "INFO: gradle distribution: ${DIST_URL:-unknown}"
fi
./gradlew -v || echo "WARNING: ./gradlew -v failed or emitted warnings"
# Refresh dependencies
./gradlew --no-daemon --refresh-dependencies dependencies || { echo "ERROR: gradle dependencies failed" >&2; exit 31; }

if [ -n "$NDK_VER" ]; then
  ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-/opt/android-sdk}
  if [ ! -d "$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/$NDK_VER" ]; then
    sdkmanager --sdk_root="$ANDROID_HOME" "ndk;$NDK_VER" || { echo "ERROR: sdkmanager install ndk;$NDK_VER failed" >&2; exit 33; }
  fi
fi

output_scripts.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE=${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/food-delivery-app-46009-46018/food_delivery_native_app}
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Use override JDK if provided
if [ -n "${JAVA_HOME_OVERRIDE:-}" ]; then
  export JAVA_HOME="$JAVA_HOME_OVERRIDE"
  export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
fi
# Print detected Gradle distribution
if [ -f gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties ]; then
  DIST_URL=$(awk -F= '/distributionUrl/ {print $2; exit}' gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties || true)
  echo "INFO: gradle distribution: ${DIST_URL:-unknown}"
fi
# Run gradle -v and capture output to warn about Java/Gradle compatibility
if ./gradlew -v >/tmp/gradle_version.out 2>&1; then
  GREP_JAVA=$(awk -F: '/JVM|Java/ {print $2; exit}' /tmp/gradle_version.out || true)
  if command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    JAVA_VER_RAW=$(java -version 2>&1 | awk -F '"' 'NR==1{print $2}' || true)
    if [[ "$JAVA_VER_RAW" == 17* ]]; then
      # warn if gradle-wrapper distribution looks older (Gradle <7 may be incompatible with Java 17)
      if echo "$DIST_URL" | grep -Eo '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        GV=$(echo "$DIST_URL" | grep -Eo '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+' | head -n1)
        MAJOR=$(echo "$GV" | cut -d. -f1 || echo 0)
        if [ "${MAJOR:-0}" -lt 7 ]; then
          echo "WARNING: Java 17 detected (java -version: $JAVA_VER_RAW) but Gradle distribution appears to be $GV — this may be incompatible. Consider setting JAVA_HOME_OVERRIDE to a Java 11 JDK." >&2
        fi
      else
        echo "INFO: Could not determine Gradle numeric version; ensure Gradle is compatible with Java 17 if using it." 
      fi
    fi
  fi
else
  echo "WARNING: ./gradlew -v failed or emitted warnings (see /tmp/gradle_version.out)" >&2
fi
# Refresh Gradle dependencies (no assemble)
if ! ./gradlew --no-daemon --refresh-dependencies dependencies; then
  echo "ERROR: gradle dependencies failed" >&2
  exit 31
fi
# Install JS deps only if project uses them
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  if ! npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; then
    echo "ERROR: npm ci failed" >&2
    exit 32
  fi
fi
# Detect NDK requirement: read ndkVersion from gradle.properties if present
NDK_VER=$(awk -F= '/^ndkVersion/ {gsub(/ /,"",$2); print $2; exit}' gradle.properties 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -n "$NDK_VER" ]; then
  ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-/opt/android-sdk}
  export ANDROID_HOME
  # ensure sdkmanager in PATH
  if ! command -v sdkmanager >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: sdkmanager not found in PATH; Android SDK command-line tools must be installed before installing NDK" >&2
    exit 34
  fi
  if [ ! -d "$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/$NDK_VER" ]; then
    if ! sdkmanager --sdk_root="$ANDROID_HOME" "ndk;$NDK_VER"; then
      echo "ERROR: sdkmanager install ndk;$NDK_VER failed" >&2
      exit 33
    fi
  else
    echo "INFO: ndk $NDK_VER already installed, skipping"
  fi
fi
exit 0

steps.name: validation - build APK, verify artifact and attempt install/start/stop on connected device
steps.description: Build an Android debug APK using the Gradle wrapper, locate the APK artifact, inspect metadata using aapt/aapt2 and verify with apksigner/zipalign when available. If adb and a device are present, install the APK, attempt to start the app (am start or monkey), force-stop it, and uninstall. If no device is present, explicitly report that START/STOP tests were skipped. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace-code-generation/food-delivery-app-46009-46018/food_delivery_native_app.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE=${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/food-delivery-app-46009-46018/food_delivery_native_app}
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Build debug APK
./gradlew assembleDebug || { echo "ERROR: assembleDebug failed" >&2; exit 41; }
# Find APK
APK=$(find "$WORKSPACE" -type f -name "*-debug.apk" | head -n 1 || true)
[ -n "$APK" ] || { echo "ERROR: APK not found" >&2; exit 42; }
stat -c '%n %s bytes' "$APK"
# Locate aapt/aapt2/apksigner/zipalign from build-tools
ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-/opt/android-sdk}
AAPT_BIN=""
for d in "$ANDROID_HOME"/build-tools/*; do
  [ -d "$d" ] || continue
  if [ -x "$d/aapt" ]; then AAPT_BIN="$d/aapt"; break; fi
  if [ -x "$d/aapt2" ]; then AAPT_BIN="$d/aapt2"; break; fi
done
APKSIGNER_BIN=$(find "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools" -maxdepth 2 -type f -executable -name 'apksigner' -print -quit || true)
ZIPALIGN_BIN=$(find "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools" -maxdepth 2 -type f -executable -name 'zipalign' -print -quit || true)
if [ -n "$AAPT_BIN" ]; then "$AAPT_BIN" dump badging "$APK" | head -n 5 || true; else echo "INFO: aapt/aapt2 not found; skipping badging"; fi
if [ -n "$APKSIGNER_BIN" ]; then "$APKSIGNER_BIN" verify --print-certs "$APK" || echo "WARNING: apksigner verify failed" >&2; else echo "INFO: apksigner not found; skipping signature check"; fi
if [ -n "$ZIPALIGN_BIN" ]; then "$ZIPALIGN_BIN" -c -v 4 "$APK" || echo "WARNING: zipalign check failed" >&2; else echo "INFO: zipalign not found; skipping check"; fi
# If adb available and a device connected, attempt install/start/stop/uninstall
if command -v adb >/dev/null 2>&1 && adb devices | sed -n '2,$p' | grep -q "device"; then
  PACKAGE=""
  if [ -n "$AAPT_BIN" ]; then PACKAGE=$("$AAPT_BIN" dump badging "$APK" 2>/dev/null | awk -F"'" '/package: name=/{print $2; exit}') || true; fi
  adb install -r "$APK" || { echo "WARNING: adb install failed" >&2; }
  if [ -n "$PACKAGE" ]; then
    # Try to start main activity: use monkey if activity unknown
    adb shell monkey -p "$PACKAGE" -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "INFO: app started" || echo "WARNING: app start attempt failed" >&2
    adb shell am force-stop "$PACKAGE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "WARNING: force-stop failed" >&2
    adb uninstall "$PACKAGE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "WARNING: adb uninstall failed" >&2
  else
    echo "INFO: package name unknown; attempted install only; skipping start/stop";
  fi
else
  echo "INFO: adb/device not present: START/STOP tests skipped"
fi
echo "VALIDATION_OK: APK=$APK"
